body.x: 1Drop Co., Ltd. participated in CES 2022, which was held in Las Vegas from January 5th to 7th.

1Drop is a technologically innovative global leading mobile healthcare company that is growing rapidly through innovative solutions necessary for disease prevention, improvement and management. They offer differentiated business strategies and technologies such as a mobile healthcare business that can measure various blood components with smartphones and biosensors, as well as a molecular diagnosis business that enables stable detection with 1Drop's innovative technology.

1drop™ introduceda chronic disease management solution using smartphones at CES 2022. It is a digital healthcare solution that allows users to easily manage their health without a separate measuring device, andusing just a smartphone app (Android, iOS) and a disposable in vitro diagnostic biosensor.
It is measured by inserting a 1drop™ cartridge into a commercial smartphone and a droplet of capillary blood.The measurement results can then be easily bechecked onthe app provided.

1Drop participated in CES 2022 as part of the Korea Health Industry Development Institute's (KHIDI) Startup Leap Package support project. The KHIDI Startup Center opened in March 2018 in order to encourage more startup and revitalize the ecosystem. Excellent ideas and technologies are discovered, and dedicated project managers (PMs) are deployed to provide support inprofessional consulting, technical evaluation, investment attraction, and market support.

Meanwhile, CES, the world's largest IT exhibition, is an exhibition where you can grasp the flow of the global home appliance industry at a glance. It is hosted by the Consumer Technology Association (CTA) and is held every January. AVING NEWS, which has been covering CES for 16 consecutive years, has been sending the most news around the world every year since 2006, and will host 'Best of CES 2022' to select the best innovative products and technologies and 'BEST OF MADE IN KOREA' to select notable Korean companies. In addition, AVING LIVE, which conveys issues at the CES site, will be held for 7 days including Media Day.
